verdict.rationale: Shopify (not itself an AI agent) documents and runtime-verifies official MCP servers (Catalog MCP, Order MCP, Cart MCP, per-merchant storefront UCP endpoints) that let AI agents authenticate, search catalogs, build carts/checkout, and track orders, with live handshake and tool-call probes confirming real functionality. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-Shopify) hands-on adoption reports beyond Shopify's own probes.
